notes.title: NOTE: Early Access Info and localisation
notes.content:
Hi Community 

This is an early access title and should show up as early access within the next 24 hours once valve has marked it as early access.

Localisation is currently being done and should be ready within the Next 48
hours.

Localised languages
[list]
    [*]German
    [*]Spanish
    [*]Italian
    [*]French
[/list]

We look forward to working closely with the community to improve and expand the game.

Big thanks 
[b]Reversed Interactive [/b]
